name: Polish Cauliflower with Breadcrumbs
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Boil the cauliflower for about 10 minutes.
Melt some butter in the oven or a microwave.
Mix the butter with the breadcrumbs, and add dill if using.
Drain the cauliflower and add the mixture on top.

culture.text: Cauliflower with breadcrumbs is a popular dish and side-dish in Poland and many parts of Central Europe. It's really simple to make.
